changelog: Settings now has a Default GST % box. Put 18 in it and every new order line picks up 18% GST automatically, added on top of the amount.

GST is never forced. A category can carry its own GST %, and any single line can be given its own — most specific wins: the line, then the category, then the Settings default. Leave everything blank or 0 and no GST is charged.
The Add Item box and every order line now have a GST % field you can type into, with the GST amount shown under the line amount and rolled into the grand total as you type.

The Categories screen is now the one place to set everything up: name, icon, description, sort order, Active / Public, Needs design, the calculation type (Qty × Rate, ft × ft, or Mixed) and the GST % — plus the component list.
The printed bill now says GST instead of Tax.
